title: atoll catalog verify --json
description: What SQLite's integrity check and foreign key check say is wrong with the catalog, then each disk compared with it, as a scan would, writing nothing (specs.md §9, §25).

problems.description: Each a line for a reader, worded by SQLite or as a row without its parent; no contract on the wording. With one, the disks are not compared.

disks.description: Each disk not failed, in configuration order, as atoll scan --json gives it, with what a scan would have recorded: new files, copies changed, moved, absent, paths taken. hashed is 0, as nothing is read whole.
